newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN CABINET SETS AGRICULTURAL BANK ISSUE PRICE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN CABINET SETS AGRICULTURAL BANK ISSUE PRICE.

text.p: The Lithuanian government said on Thursday that the price for the upcoming share issue of the state-run Agricultural Bank will be no less than 175 litas per share, which is the face value of its current shares.
"The cabinet approved the decision that the share issue price of the Agricultural Bank should be no less than 175 litas," the government's press office said in a statement.
The bank decided last month to boost its share capital by 42.875 million litas to meet the minimum capital adequacy ratio requirement of ten percent set by the country's central bank.
The current share capital of the bank stands at 128 million litas.
The bank said on Wednesday that its unaudited net profit for the first half of the year was 13.233 million litas. Its net profit for 1996 was over 25 million litas.
The bank, the country's second largest in terms of assets, has been slated for privatisation.
